problem_text: Find all functions f:(0,∞)→(0,∞) such that for any x,y∈(0,∞), xf(x²)f(f(y)) + f(yf(x)) = f(xy)(f(f(x²)) + f(f(y²))).
solution_text: Guess f(x)=1/x and verify by substitution. Compute each term: f(x²)=1/x², f(f(y))=y, f(yf(x))=f(y/x)=x/y, f(xy)=1/(xy), f(f(x²))=x², f(f(y²))=y². LHS = x·(1/x²)·y + x/y = y/x + x/y = (x²+y²)/(xy). RHS = (1/(xy))·(x²+y²) = (x²+y²)/(xy). Both sides equal, so f(x)=1/x satisfies the equation.
solution_summary: Guess f(x)=1/x based on the involution structure of f(f(·)) terms, then verify by direct substitution that both sides simplify to (x²+y²)/(xy).
